read_sources: canonical WEB Daniel coordinates and text

non_authority_statement: Candidate literary/structural evidence only. No theology, canon, authorship, date, historicity, miracle, ethics, identity, chronology, fulfillment, preferred witness/reading/translation/source tradition, graph, retrieval, promotion, or reviewed-gold authority.
routing_principle: Prefer complete court tales, dream/vision plus interpretation, prayer-response movements, and the continuous Daniel 10-12 revelation. Split internally only at clear scene, report, interpretation, prayer, messenger-dialogue, or closure seams; preserve cumulative lists and symbolic sequences.

macro_parent_alternatives.preservation_reason: Selection, food test, enablement, examination, and tenure notice form one arc.

macro_parent_alternatives.form: complete dream-crisis, revelation, interpretation, and outcome tale
macro_parent_alternatives.preservation_reason: Peril, prayer, disclosed dream, interpretation, and reversal depend on one another.

macro_parent_alternatives.form: complete image, accusation, furnace, deliverance, and decree tale
macro_parent_alternatives.preservation_reason: Repeated lists serve one escalating court-tale arc.

macro_parent_alternatives.form: royal proclamation enclosing dream, interpretation, fulfillment, restoration, and praise
macro_parent_alternatives.preservation_reason: The proclamation frame interprets the whole experience.

macro_parent_alternatives.form: complete feast, writing, interpretation, and fall tale
macro_parent_alternatives.preservation_reason: The sign and explanation reach their same-night outcome.

macro_parent_alternatives.form: complete conspiracy, prayer, den, deliverance, judgment, and decree tale
macro_parent_alternatives.preservation_reason: The decree creates the peril resolved by the den and proclamation.

macro_parent_alternatives.form: complete beasts, heavenly-court, human-like-figure vision and interpretation
macro_parent_alternatives.preservation_reason: Interpretation revisits the vision and closing distress completes it.

macro_parent_alternatives.form: complete ram-goat-horn vision, interpretation, and aftermath
macro_parent_alternatives.preservation_reason: Messenger explanation and bodily aftermath complete the report.
The response arrives while the prayer is still being spoken.

macro_parent_alternatives.form: continuous final revelation: encounter, disclosure, culmination, sealing, closing dialogue
macro_parent_alternatives.preservation_reason: The messenger speech crosses both chapter seams.

global_hot_zones.issue: Hebrew-Aramaic transition occurs within the verse.
global_hot_zones.handling: Macro-architecture evidence only; no verse-half coordinate, source, author, or date decision.

global_hot_zones.issue: Old Greek/Theodotion length and addition pressure.
global_hot_zones.handling: Prefer no witness; import no Greek additions; preserve scoped tale.

global_hot_zones.issue: Proclamation voice and chronology invite source-layer claims.
global_hot_zones.handling: Preserve macro parent; decide no source, date, or historicity.
Respect received coordinates; keep Dan.5.31-Dan.6.1 as alternative; identify no ruler.
Keep in heavenly-court movement; decide no identity or fulfillment.

global_hot_zones.issue: Horn, sanctuary, ruler, time, and translation disputes.
global_hot_zones.handling: Keep vision-interpretation pair; defer identities and chronology.

global_hot_zones.issue: Seventy-weeks syntax, translation, segmentation, chronology, fulfillment.
global_hot_zones.handling: Keep whole messenger response LOW; calculate no dates.

global_hot_zones.issue: Ruler identity and possible referent-shift pressure.
global_hot_zones.handling: Use discourse seams only; defer identity and chronology.
Preserve culmination and closing dialogue; decide no doctrine or schedule.

units.title: Siege setting and court selection of Judean youths
units.literary_form: court-tale exposition and identity reassignment
units.deciding_marker: Siege and vessels lead to recruitment, named entrants, and court names; verse 8 begins Daniel's counter-action.
units.rejected_alternative: Do not isolate 1:1-2 as a historical proof text or split each criterion/name.
units.risk: Chronology, exile historicity, names, and court terms remain deferred.

units.title: Food test, enablement, and successful examination
units.literary_form: test-and-vindication court-tale movement
units.deciding_marker: Daniel's resolve initiates request, test, result, gifts, examination, standing, and tenure closure.
units.rejected_alternative: Do not detach the test from examination/outcome or isolate 1:17.
units.risk: Dietary ethics, miracle, chronology, and vision claims remain deferred.

units.title: Impossible royal demand and death decree
units.literary_form: dream-crisis court dialogue and peril escalation
units.deciding_marker: Repeated king-wise-men exchange culminates in the death decree; Daniel intervenes at verse 14.
units.rejected_alternative: Do not split repeated demands or the within-verse language change.
units.risk: Aramaic transition, royal psychology, wording, titles, source, and date remain deferred.

units.title: Daniel seeks mercy, receives the secret, and blesses God
units.literary_form: intervention, communal petition, night revelation, and hymn
units.deciding_marker: Daniel redirects the crisis to prayer; disclosure produces a bounded blessing before return to Arioch.
units.rejected_alternative: Do not isolate the hymn from prayer/revelation or make 2:19 stand alone.
units.risk: Providence, prayer efficacy, kingship, and historical claims remain non-authoritative.

units.title: Court entry, image dream, and interpretation
units.literary_form: court presentation containing dream report and interpretation
units.deciding_marker: Arioch brings Daniel before the king; framing, dream, explicit interpretation formula, and explanation answer one demand.
units.rejected_alternative: Do not sever 2:31-35 from 2:36-45 or isolate metals, stone, kingdoms, or 2:44.
units.risk: Every kingdom, metal, stone, chronology, and fulfillment identity is deferred.

units.title: Royal acknowledgment, elevation, and appointments
units.literary_form: recognition and status-reversal closure
units.deciding_marker: The king's response follows completed interpretation; promotions close peril-to-honor reversal.
units.rejected_alternative: Do not detach acknowledgment from appointments or make it theology authority.
units.risk: Royal speech/action is narrative evidence, not reviewer endorsement.

units.title: Image dedication and universal worship command
units.literary_form: court spectacle, herald decree, and collective compliance
units.deciding_marker: Image, officials, herald, instrument refrain, sanction, and compliance establish the test; accusation begins at verse 8.
units.rejected_alternative: Do not atomize official/instrument lists or repeated image formulas.
units.risk: Dimensions, titles, loanwords, empire, and theology remain deferred.

units.title: Accusation, ultimatum, and refusal
units.literary_form: accusation and confrontation dialogue
units.deciding_marker: Accusers cite the decree, the king threatens, and the three answer; changed appearance at verse 19 starts execution.
units.rejected_alternative: Do not isolate 3:17-18 or detach the answer from accusation/ultimatum.
units.risk: Ethics, miracle expectation, divine action, and conditional syntax remain deferred.

units.title: Furnace, deliverance, decree, and promotion
units.literary_form: peril, witnessed deliverance, proclamation, and closure
units.deciding_marker: Furnace action moves through astonishment and inspection to blessing, decree, and promotion.
units.rejected_alternative: Do not isolate the fourth figure, deliverance, or decree from the reversal.
units.risk: Fourth-figure identity, miracle, violence, witness length, and additions remain deferred.

units.title: Royal proclamation and opening praise
units.literary_form: proclamation superscription and hymnic thesis
units.deciding_marker: Addressee, greeting, purpose, and praise frame first-person testimony beginning at verse 4.
units.rejected_alternative: Do not detach the praise from its proclamation frame.
units.risk: Voice does not settle composition, source, historicity, or theology.

units.title: Royal dream of the tree and watcher
units.literary_form: first-person court dream report with embedded decree
units.deciding_marker: Tranquility, failed interpreters, Daniel's arrival, tree, watcher speech, and request form one dream report.
units.rejected_alternative: Do not split tree, watcher decree, seven-times formula, or summons.
units.risk: Watcher identity, tree referent, chronology, language, source, and date remain deferred.

units.title: Daniel's troubled interpretation and counsel
units.literary_form: interpretation dialogue and admonitory counsel
units.deciding_marker: Silence and reassurance initiate interpretation, which identifies tree, explains decree, and ends with counsel.
units.rejected_alternative: Do not detach 4:27 or split repeated tree/watcher descriptions.
units.risk: Ethics, judgment, illness, seven times, and history remain deferred.

units.title: Fulfillment, abasement, restoration, and praise
units.literary_form: narrated fulfillment and first-person restoration doxology
units.deciding_marker: Fulfillment notice initiates reversal; restored first-person speech returns at verse 34 and closes in praise.
units.rejected_alternative: Do not detach restoration hymn from fulfillment or isolate abasement.
units.risk: Historicity, diagnosis, chronology, miracle, and theology remain deferred.

units.title: Feast, vessels, handwriting, and failed wise men
units.literary_form: court feast disrupted by an unexplained sign
units.deciding_marker: Feast and vessels lead to hand, terror, reward, and failure; queen enters at verse 10.
units.rejected_alternative: Do not isolate vessels, hand, inscription, or failed interpreters.
units.risk: Kinship, vessels, chronology, hand identity, and historicity remain deferred.

units.title: Queen identifies Daniel and the king summons him
units.literary_form: advisor speech and interpreter-summons dialogue
units.deciding_marker: Queen recommends Daniel; he is brought in and the king restates crisis/reward before verse 17 answer.
units.rejected_alternative: Do not split recommendation from summons or atomize court titles.
units.risk: Queen, father, and title identities and history remain deferred.

units.title: Indictment, interpretation, investiture, and fall
units.literary_form: court rebuke, sign interpretation, ironic honor, and reversal
units.deciding_marker: Daniel refuses gifts, compares, indicts, interprets, and the same-night outcome follows.
units.rejected_alternative: Do not isolate MENE-TEKEL-PERES, indictment, or 5:30-31 from outcome.
units.risk: Wordplay, translation, rulers, transition, and versification remain deferred.

units.title: Elevation, conspiracy, and unalterable decree
units.literary_form: appointment, conspiracy, and decree setup
units.deciding_marker: Placement produces investigation and petition culminating in signed decree; Daniel responds at verse 10.
units.rejected_alternative: Do not atomize officer list, decree terms, or law formula.
units.risk: Numbers, ruler identity, legal history, and historicity remain deferred.

units.title: Prayer, accusation, and failed royal rescue
units.literary_form: counter-action, surveillance, accusation, and royal resistance
units.deciding_marker: Daniel's response is observed/prosecuted; accusers close every royal escape before verse 16.
units.rejected_alternative: Do not isolate 6:10 or detach accusation from the decree trap.
units.risk: Prayer practice, law, ethics, and application remain deferred.

units.title: Sealed den, deliverance, judgment, decree, and prosperity
units.literary_form: peril/deliverance with violent reversal and proclamation
units.deciding_marker: Casting and sealing lead to morning return, release, counter-judgment, decree, and closure.
units.rejected_alternative: Do not isolate angel report, royal hymn, or violent judgment from den outcome.
units.risk: Angel identity, miracle, collective punishment, violence, confession, and chronology remain deferred.

units.title: Four sea beasts and the arrogant little horn
units.literary_form: dated first-person symbolic dream report
units.deciding_marker: Repeated 'I saw' advances four beasts to horn focus before thrones are placed.
units.rejected_alternative: Do not split each beast/horn or infer kingdoms before interpretation.
units.risk: Beast, horn, kingdom, chronology, language, and fulfillment identities remain deferred.

units.title: Heavenly court judges and grants dominion
units.literary_form: heavenly-court vision and dominion grant
units.deciding_marker: Thrones, court, books, judgment, and cloud-borne approach form one scene; distress begins at verse 15.
units.rejected_alternative: Do not isolate 7:13-14 from the court or decide the figure by later reuse.
units.risk: Ancient, human-like figure, service, kingdom, identity, fulfillment, and theology remain deferred.

units.title: Interpretation of beasts, horn, judgment, and kingdom
units.literary_form: angelic interpretation dialogue with closing reaction
units.deciding_marker: Distress and inquiry initiate interpretation; follow-up question yields detail and explicit closure.
units.rejected_alternative: Do not detach first answer, isolate time formula, or sever final reaction.
units.risk: Kings, kingdoms, horn, saints, times, judgment, and fulfillment remain deferred.

units.title: Ram, goat, horn, sanctuary crisis, and question
units.literary_form: dated symbolic vision with intravision dialogue
units.deciding_marker: Superscription and location open ram-goat-horn sequence; holy ones' question stays in the vision.
units.rejected_alternative: Do not split each horn/direction/sanctuary element or 2,300 evenings-mornings.
units.risk: Ruler, horn, sanctuary, offering, number, translation, chronology, and fulfillment remain deferred.

units.title: Gabriel commissioned to interpret the vision
units.literary_form: messenger encounter and symbolic interpretation
units.deciding_marker: Daniel seeks understanding; commissioning voice, touch, and explanation run to sealing instruction.
units.rejected_alternative: Do not separate encounter from explanation or atomize interpreted symbols.
units.risk: Gabriel, kings, end, sanctuary, numbers, wording, and fulfillment remain deferred.

units.title: Sickness, return to duty, and incomprehension
units.literary_form: vision-aftermath closure notice
units.deciding_marker: First-person bodily/vocational aftermath follows sealed interpretation and closes the report.
units.rejected_alternative: Do not discard the aftermath or override the whole-chapter macro parent.
units.risk: Illness, understanding, and court service remain narrative evidence only.

units.title: Daniel reads Jeremiah and turns to prayer
units.literary_form: dated scripture-reading and prayer-orientation frame
units.deciding_marker: Setting, book-based understanding, and resolve introduce direct prayer at verse 4.
units.rejected_alternative: Do not isolate seventy years or detach reading from prayer.
units.risk: Rulers, Jeremiah relation, seventy years, chronology, and harmonization remain deferred.

units.title: Confession and petition for Jerusalem
units.literary_form: communal confessional prayer and urgent petition
units.deciding_marker: Direct address sustains confession, appeal, exodus recollection, and petitions through 'Lord, hear.'
units.rejected_alternative: Do not split confession, law reference, petition, or 9:19 into proof texts.
units.risk: Covenant, sin, law, exile, corporate responsibility, and theology remain deferred.

units.title: Gabriel arrives and gives the seventy-weeks response
units.literary_form: prayer-response encounter and compressed temporal oracle
units.deciding_marker: 'While I was speaking' binds arrival to prayer; commissioning and discourse run to chapter end.
units.rejected_alternative: Do not calculate or split 9:24-27 by anointed one, covenant, sacrifice, or desolation.
units.risk: Syntax, translation, sevens, identities, chronology, and fulfillment are maximally deferred.

units.title: Superscription, mourning, river appearance, and collapse
units.literary_form: final-revelation superscription and overwhelming encounter
units.deciding_marker: Message summary, mourning, river location, appearance, flight, and collapse prepare for touch at verse 10.
units.rejected_alternative: Do not split body-part imagery or detach superscription/mourning from encounter.
units.risk: Messenger identity, chronology, warfare, place, appearance, and history remain deferred.

units.title: Messenger strengthens Daniel and explains delay
units.literary_form: touch-and-speech dialogue framing final disclosure
units.deciding_marker: Repeated touches restore Daniel; explanation of delay/purpose/support continues through 11:1.
units.rejected_alternative: Do not cut at chapter boundary or isolate celestial princes.
units.risk: Messenger, Michael, princes, celestial conflict, chronology, and identities remain deferred.

units.title: Successive rulers and north-south conflicts
units.literary_form: compressed dynastic-war disclosure
units.deciding_marker: 'Now I will show' starts succession/conflict sequence through brief tax-collector successor; contemptible person begins at verse 21.
units.rejected_alternative: Do not split every king, marriage, campaign, fortress, island, tax, or succession.
units.risk: Every ruler, campaign, chronology, referent, translation, and fulfillment remains deferred.

units.title: Contemptible ruler, covenant conflict, and ordeal of the wise
units.literary_form: disclosure focused on one escalating antagonist
units.deciding_marker: Replacement introduces a figure whose flatteries, campaigns, covenant hostility, profanation, and persecution run through appointed-time refrain.
units.rejected_alternative: Do not isolate covenant prince, abomination, wise, persecution modes, or end phrases.
units.risk: Ruler, covenant, sanctuary, offering, abomination, violence, chronology, translation, and fulfillment remain deferred.

units.title: Self-exalting king's final campaigns and end
units.literary_form: climactic antagonist portrait and campaign sequence
units.deciding_marker: Renewed king subject expands exaltation, cult, power, conflict, sweep, alarm, and unassisted end; 12:1 continues 'at that time.'
units.rejected_alternative: Do not force an identity shift at verse 36 or atomize gods, nations, rumors, and campaigns.
units.risk: Referent shift, ruler/nation identity, theology, geography, chronology, translation, and fulfillment remain deferred.

units.title: Trouble, deliverance, awakening, the wise, and sealing
units.literary_form: culmination and sealing instruction
units.deciding_marker: 'At that time' continues prior disclosure; deliverance, awakening, shining wise, and sealing command form its culmination.
units.rejected_alternative: Do not isolate 12:2-3 or split deliverance, awakening, wise, and sealing motifs.
units.risk: Michael, book, resurrection, judgment, wise, end, knowledge, chronology, fulfillment, and theology remain deferred.

units.title: River-bank questions, time formulas, and dismissal
units.literary_form: closing vision dialogue and personal commission
units.deciding_marker: Two others appear; questions ask how long/outcome, and replies end with repeated dismissal and assurance.
units.rejected_alternative: Do not calculate/split each number or detach 12:13 from the continuous revelation.
units.risk: Messenger identities, oath, all time numbers, refining, rest, inheritance, chronology, resurrection, fulfillment, and theology remain deferred.
